title: BetterPlugins
description:
A better list of plugins
更好的插件列表
body:
这是一个使你的插件列表更加整洁的插件
This is a key to make your plug-in list more important

/pl /plugins
————打开插件列表(有首字母索引)
————Open the plug-in list(There is an initial index in it)

/pl 文字 /plugins 文字
————搜索插件(不需要插件名完整)
————search plugin(The input name can be incomplete)

点击插件名字，就可以进入插件的简介面板，如果需要控制插件的启动关闭和重载，需安装[PlugmanX](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/plugmanx.88135/)
Click the name of the plug-in to enter the introduction of the plug-in
If you need to control the startup and shutdown of plug-ins, you need to install [PlugmanX](https://www.spigotmc.org/resources/plugmanx.88135/)

配置文件中可以设置语言
You can set the language in the config
